theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_nonflat_closed
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S Dset : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < β → IsClosed S → IsOpen Dset → IsClosed (((S ∩ Dset) \ {w | ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball w ρ ⊆ Dset ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∃ s : ℝ, s < β * ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, y ∈ ball w ρ → ‖(y - w) - Q.starProjection (y - w)‖ ≤ s}) ∪ Dsetᶜ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
